instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.finishSound: Don’t forget to mention your name.

atoms.b: August is the ((eighth)) month of the year.
atoms.finishSound: August is the eighth month of the year.

atoms.b: Have you been ((naughty)) or nice this year?
atoms.finishSound: Have you been naughty or nice this year?

atoms.b: I am listening to the most ((popular)) song at the moment.
atoms.finishSound: I am listening to the most popular song at the moment.

atoms.b: Next year, I’ll go to a ((grammar)) school.
atoms.finishSound: Next year, I’ll go to a grammar school.

atoms.b: I am ((certain)) that maths will be cancelled tomorrow.
atoms.finishSound: I am certain that maths will be cancelled tomorrow.
